title: The Pass Stays Closed
hook: The valley still holds. The climb does not.
scene: Overcast afternoon on I-90 east, still in the valley. From high up the Ledger is a small gray box in the right lane, rolling, wet pavement edge to edge. Downtown is already behind. Ahead the same three lanes continue toward a mountain that stays a shape, not a road. No plow, no chain-up bay, no night. Ali is a voice on the radio: the Backcountry is next if the schedule wants gravel. The pass keeps its own act.
debrief: The shuttle is still on valley I-90. The mountain is only a shape. The climb, the dark, and the weather wait.

source.teaching_target: Cliffhanger: Ribbon ends on the valley floor; Snoqualmie / chains / night / snow belong to Act VII; rural is Act VI.
